rule: For each changed category retain only if exact_correct is not lower, false_accepts/false_rejects/errors/unknown_usage are not higher than paired baseline, and at least one of exact_correct, false_accepts, false_rejects, input_tokens or observed median HTTP latency improves. Otherwise revert that category to baseline. No new wording may be designed from validation. Freeze final mix before any test dispatch.
latency_limit: Observed tie-break, not proof of a statistically reliable latency gain.
